description:
Prism is a wallpaper app for people who care how their iPhone looks. Find a wall you love, make your own with AI, and save it to Photos in a tap.

New in Prism

• Folders. Save walls into private folders, make a folder public, or follow someone else's.
• Widgets. Put the Wall of the Day and your streak on your Home Screen and Lock Screen.
• Spatial Scene walls. Prism marks the walls that make strong iOS 26 Spatial Scenes, and you can tilt a 3D preview before you save.
• Duo reveal walls for iPhone Duo. One scene when it is folded, another when you open it.
• AI styles and remix. Describe an idea, see it in every style, then remix the AI walls you like.
• Weekly challenges. Enter the theme of the week and vote for your favourites. The winner becomes the Wall of the Day.
• Creators. Find new artists through the people you follow, and tip the ones you love with coins.

4K and AMOLED walls

• Sharp 4K walls and true-black AMOLED backgrounds
• A new Wall of the Day every morning
• Browse by category and mood, or search by word, colour or tag
• A feed that learns what you like
• Preview any wall on a real Home Screen and Lock Screen first
• Depth Effect tags show which walls can sit in front of the clock

Make your own with AI

Type an idea, pick a style from anime to oil painting, and Prism creates a wallpaper from your idea. Ask for another take, refine it with a follow-up, or remix a wall someone else made. AI wallpapers cost coins, and you can earn coins in the app.

Your library

• Favourites, Folders, Downloads and History in one place
• Pin up to 12 favourites
• Your history follows you to a new phone when you sign in

Made with the community

• Upload your own walls. Every upload is reviewed before it goes live
• Ask for a wallpaper and vote on other people's requests
• Share a wall as a story, a post or a clean card, or send it to Instagram Stories
• Report content or block users at any time

Make it yours

• Light and dark themes, AMOLED black and your own accent colour
• Change your wallpaper automatically with Shortcuts, even from a folder
• Browse without an account, and sign in when you want to save

Prism Pro

Prism Pro comes monthly, yearly or as a one-time lifetime purchase:

• Every premium wallpaper and collection
• Free downloads and free filters
• No ads
• AI wallpapers at half the coins, with no watermark

Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings. Terms of Use: https://prismwalls.com/terms. Privacy Policy: https://prismwalls.com/privacy.
promotionalText: New: folders, Home and Lock Screen widgets, Spatial Scene and Duo reveal walls, and weekly challenges where the winner becomes the Wall of the Day.
whatsNew:
• Tip the creators you love with coins, from a wall or a profile
• Find new creators in the Creators to follow row, and see who you follow already follows them
• Creators get a Stats page that shows how their walls do each week
• Edit the title, description and tags of your uploads
• Shuffle your wallpaper from a folder with Shortcuts
• If a premium filter fails, your coins come back by themselves
• Security and stability fixes
